newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Apollo Group targets raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Apollo Group targets raised.

text.p: --EVEREN Securities Inc said Friday it raised price targets on the stock of Apollo Group Inc to $29 from $25 for the six months and to $37 from $35 for the 18 months.
--It said it increased the targets to reflect recent upward revisions in its earnings estimates for FY97 (August) of $0.58 from $0.55 and for FY98 of $0.76 from $0.72.
--Apollo, an adult higher education services company, was trading at 32-7/8, up 5/8.
